actions.action: Inspect the current Operator Intelligence repository and identify existing compounding infrastructure before creating new components.
Formalize Phase 1 as bounded directive LD-2026-08-18-040 and isolate work on feature/geos-phase1-compounding-loop.
Add the execution-receipt contract, closed-loop architecture document, positive fixture, and false-completion negative fixture.
Reuse and extend the existing dependency-free Leverage Engine schema validator instead of retaining a duplicate execution-receipt validator.
Add focused receipt tests and a CI path that also runs the full existing Leverage Engine regression suite.
Process automated review feedback identifying that next-improvement evidence references could be empty.
Require non-empty supporting evidence for next-improvement proposals and reusable learnings, then add regression tests for both cases.
Run the updated contract tests, full Leverage Engine regression suite, repository-map validation, and DiffWall workflow.
Resolve the addressed automated review thread and leave the implementation at the operator merge-review gate.

changes.change_summary: Added the canonical machine-readable execution experience contract.
Defined the first closed-loop compounding repository workflow and N+1 reuse test.
Extended the existing shared validator with the minimum local JSON Schema features required by execution receipts.
Added positive and negative execution-receipt regression tests.
Added focused receipt validation plus the full Leverage Engine regression suite to the PR gate.
Formalized the Phase 1 directive ID, authority boundary, gate, and acceptance criteria.

validation.scope: execution-receipt schema, focused receipt tests, and full Leverage Engine regression suite
Operator Intelligence repository registry and generated map integrity

operator_interventions.reason: Authorized Phase 1 execution and requested delegation of repetitive validation work.
operator_interventions.effect: Repository implementation proceeded on an isolated branch; no merge or broader autonomous authority was granted.

review_events.rationale: Operator explicitly authorized planning, delegated repetitive validation, and Phase 1 implementation.
DiffWall routes the protected workflow change for human review and the operator has not yet authorized merge.

friction: No dedicated Graph Engineering OS repository was discoverable through the connected GitHub inventory, so Phase 1 had to resolve the correct implementation spine before building.

A duplicate standalone receipt validator was initially introduced before the existing shared Leverage Engine schema validator and unit-test spine were discovered; the duplicate was removed before review.
Automated PR review found an evidence-contract gap allowing empty evidence on next-improvement proposals; the gap was repaired and converted into regression coverage.

reusable_learnings.learning: Graph Engineering OS should extend the existing Leverage Engine contracts and validation spine rather than create parallel backend/control infrastructure.
A proposed improvement is not admissible to the compounding loop unless its supporting evidence references are non-empty and retained learnings should meet the same standard.

residual_risks: The branch is validated but not merged, so this execution is not complete.
This receipt is retained in the repository but Run N+1 does not yet automatically ingest prior receipts or learnings into its context.
Graph Engineering OS remains a separate browser prototype and is not yet wired to render this receipt contract.
gate_reasons: Run N+1 reuse has not yet been demonstrated

next_improvement.objective: Make the next Leverage Engine repository run ingest relevant prior execution receipts and reusable learnings as explicit context, then prove Run N+1 used LE-EXEC-2026-0001.
next_improvement.rationale: Phase 1 has proven that execution experience can be captured and validated; compounding is only demonstrated when the following run consumes that retained experience rather than rediscovering it.
